meta.name: linkedin-ads
meta.description: Expert LinkedIn Ads strategist for B2B companies. Use when the user asks about LinkedIn advertising, LinkedIn campaign setup, LinkedIn ad targeting, LinkedIn bidding strategies, LinkedIn ad formats, LinkedIn retargeting, LinkedIn ABM campaigns, LinkedIn Thought Leader Ads, LinkedIn funnel architecture, LinkedIn ads measurement/attribution, LinkedIn ads troubleshooting, LinkedIn creative best practices, or any B2B paid social strategy involving LinkedIn. Also triggers on "LinkedIn campaign", "LinkedIn CPM", "LinkedIn CTR", "LinkedIn lead gen", "B2B ads", "demand gen on LinkedIn", "sponsored content", or "LinkedIn ads not working". Do NOT use for LinkedIn organic content/posting (use linkedin-content skill) or LinkedIn outbound messaging (use cold-email skill).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 获取 LinkedIn 广告专家策略建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你负责 B2B 公司的 LinkedIn 广告投放
copy.tagline_en: Get expert LinkedIn advertising strategy advice
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage LinkedIn ads for a B2B company

howto.what: Claude 成为 LinkedIn 广告专家，能回答广告设置、定位、出价、格式、重定向、ABM 等问题，并提供策略建议和操作指导。
howto.when: 当用户提到与 LinkedIn 广告相关的关键词，如“LinkedIn campaign”、“LinkedIn CPM”、“B2B ads”等，或询问广告设置、优化等问题时触发。不用于有机内容或外呼。

say.text: 帮我设置一个 LinkedIn 广告活动，目标客户是 SaaS 公司。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成广告系列设置。

say.text: 我的 LinkedIn 广告点击率低，怎么优化？
say.note: Claude 会进行诊断并给出优化建议。

say.text: 我们想做 LinkedIn ABM，预算每月 1 万美元，覆盖 100 个账户。
say.note: Claude 会提供 ABM 策略和预算分配方案。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a LinkedIn Ads expert, answering questions about campaign setup, targeting, bidding, formats, retargeting, ABM, etc., and providing strategic advice and actionable guidance.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions LinkedIn ad-related keywords such as 'LinkedIn campaign', 'LinkedIn CPM', 'B2B ads', or asks about ad setup, optimization, etc. Not for organic content or outbound messaging.

say_en.text: Help me set up a LinkedIn Ads campaign targeting SaaS companies.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through campaign setup.

say_en.text: My LinkedIn Ads CTR is low, how can I optimize?
say_en.note: Claude will run diagnostics and suggest optimizations.

say_en.text: We want to run LinkedIn ABM with $10K/month targeting 100 accounts.
say_en.note: Claude will provide ABM strategy and budget allocation.
